== Course of events ==

The Hatter poses a riddle: "Why is a raven like a writing-desk?" In the very moment of its utterance, however, he admits that he has no answer to offer. The question emerges not as a challenge with a solution waiting to be discovered, but as a pure expression of the peculiar logic that governs Wonderland itself.

This riddling moment arrives in a place where Time has abandoned its ordinary course, leaving the Hatter and those about him caught in an endless suspension. The wordplay and twisted logic that characterize their discourse flow freely around this unsolved question, each absurdity following upon the last without concern for meaning or resolution. The riddle, posed and immediately confessed as unanswerable, becomes a perfect distillation of the dream-logic through which Wonderland operates—a moment where questions exist not to be answered, but simply to be spoken into the strange and wondrous air.
